subject: sr-business-studies
title: Advertising and Salesmanship
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: Advertising is a ______ form of communication.
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Publicity differs from advertising because it is —
options: not paid for by the firm
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which medium suits a company wanting to reach all strata of society with visuals?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: The first step in the selling process is —
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which of the following is a feature of salesmanship?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Outdoor advertising includes —
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which is a sales promotion tool?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which medium is suitable for rural people without electricity?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which of the following is a limitation of advertising?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Magazines are suitable for —
questions.answer: A

questions.q: After-sales service is part of which step?
questions.answer: A

questions.q: Which advertisement medium is costly but combines sound and visuals?
questions.answer: A

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark.

questions.q: Which medium of advertising is most suitable? (a) A company wants to reach a large number of people across the country at the same time. (b) A business wants to promote its product to young, tech-savvy consumers at low cost.
questions.answer: (a) Television (or newspaper). (b) Internet (social media) advertising.

questions.q: Mark A for advertising and P for publicity: (a) It is a paid form of dissemination of information. (b) There is no identified sponsor. (c) May leave a favourable or unfavourable impression.
questions.answer: (a) A. (b) P. (c) P.

questions.q: Write the steps of the selling process in order.
questions.answer: Prospecting; pre-approach; approach; presentation and demonstration; answering queries; action (closing); follow-up.

questions.q: Identify the objective of advertising: a consumer durables company issues an advertisement listing the dealers selling its products.
questions.answer: Dealer support.

questions.q: Which medium would you choose: (a) to catch the attention of people travelling by train, (b) to reach a selective segment of readers?
questions.answer: (a) Outdoor advertising. (b) Magazines.

questions.q: Write B, C or S for the benefits of salesmanship: (a) explains the uses of a product, (b) helps in planning the right type of products, (c) facilitates production, distribution and consumption.
questions.answer: (a) C. (b) B. (c) S.

questions.q: State true or false: (i) Publicity is a paid form of communication. (ii) Salesmanship is personal selling.
questions.answer: (i) False. (ii) True.

questions.q: Name the sales promotion tool: 50 g extra in a 250 g pack of tea.
questions.answer: Quantity gift (extra quantity).

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: State any two limitations of advertising.
questions.answer: It multiplies wants and adds to the cost and price of products.

questions.q: Define advertising.
questions.answer: Any paid form of non-personal presentation and promotion of ideas, goods or services by an identified sponsor.

questions.q: Differentiate between advertising and publicity on any two bases.
questions.answer: Advertising is paid and has an identified sponsor; publicity is unpaid and has no identified sponsor.

questions.q: What is salesmanship?
questions.answer: Assisting and persuading prospective customers to buy a product through face-to-face communication.

questions.q: Name any two objectives of advertising.
questions.answer: Introduction of a new product and increase in sales (also goodwill, dealer support).

questions.q: What are the benefits of advertising to society (any two)?
questions.answer: It generates employment and makes media available at affordable prices.

questions.q: Why is knowledge of the product important for a salesperson?
questions.answer: It lets the salesperson answer queries, explain features and use, and persuade the customer with confidence.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: State any three qualities of a good salesperson.
questions.answer: Good personality, thorough product knowledge and the ability to communicate and persuade (also persistence and good behaviour).

questions.q: State any three objectives of sales promotion.
questions.answer: To attract new customers, to increase sales in the short run and to introduce a new product.

questions.q: Explain any three advertising media and state their suitability.
questions.answer: Newspapers suit mass-use products and services; television suits mass-use goods and new products and reaches the illiterate; magazines suit a selective target segment.

questions.q: Differentiate between advertising and sales promotion.
questions.answer: Advertising is a non-personal, paid, long-term communication through media; sales promotion is a short-term incentive for immediate purchase.

questions.q: Explain any three tools of sales promotion.
questions.answer: Discounts, free samples and contests (also rebate, refunds, lucky draws).

questions.q: Explain the benefits of salesmanship to consumers.
questions.answer: The salesperson guides and informs the customer, explains how to use the product and gives after-sales information.

questions.q: Explain any three advantages of advertising to manufacturers.
questions.answer: It introduces new products, increases sales by attracting customers and builds goodwill.

sections.title: Long answer questions. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Explain the steps in the selling process.
questions.answer: Prospecting, pre-approach, approach, presentation and demonstration, answering objections, closing the sale and follow-up service.

questions.q: Explain the objectives of advertising.
questions.answer: New product introduction, increase in sales, retaining buyers, goodwill, dealer support, brand image and helping personal selling.

questions.q: Explain the limitations of advertising.
questions.answer: It multiplies wants, adds to cost, creates monopoly, affects values, promotes dangerous deeds, may not raise total demand and is one-way communication.

questions.q: Explain the qualities of a good salesperson.
questions.answer: Personality, mental qualities, good behaviour, knowledge, ability to communicate and persuade and persistence.

questions.q: Explain the importance of salesmanship to consumers, business and society.
questions.answer: Consumers get guidance and information; business gets more sales and feedback; society gets smooth production, distribution and consumption.

questions.q: Explain the media of advertising with their suitability.
questions.answer: Newspapers, television, radio, magazines, films, outdoor media and the internet with their reach, cost and suitable products.
